cross_platform.rule: D(y) = c_T(y) / V_T - c_I(label(y)) / V_I of ba, bb and b0 within 3.0 combined standard errors on at least 7 of 8 bins, against each of ibm_fez and ibm_marrakesh (IBM_RECORDS); the Tuna ratio is the readout_corrected one with the assignment of its own batch, the raw ratio is reported

model: contraction of the 32-outcome law toward uniform by rho^cz, then the retained single-qubit assignment; hypothesis-level
